sources.title: Use an external storage device as a Mac startup disk
sources.supported_fact: USB/Thunderbolt full macOS installation; model specific; Apple silicon requires functioning internal startup disk.

sources.title: Startup Disk security policy control for a Mac with Apple silicon
sources.supported_fact: External OS requires authenticated recoveryOS restart and per-OS LocalPolicy; not the T2 media-boot toggle.

sources.title: About Startup Security Utility on a Mac with the Apple T2 Security Chip
sources.supported_fact: Read to distinguish T2 from this arm64 host. T2 external media defaults disabled; Full Security may require updated integrity information online. Not applied to this host.

sources.title: Agent Configuration
sources.supported_fact: private-keys-v1.d contains private key files; protect backups.

sources.title: Agent Options
sources.supported_fact: Passphrase caches have default and maximum TTL; disconnect does not itself clear them.

sources.title: OpenPGP Specifics
sources.supported_fact: GnuPG compatible; one key per authentication/signing/encryption role; RSA3072/4096 supported. Capability example only, not a purchasing recommendation or proof of current owned device.

sources.title: Protecting keys with the Secure Enclave
sources.supported_fact: Security-framework interface described is P-256 and creates keys in hardware. Does not establish OpenPGP RSA support; no assertion that every Secure Enclave interface or chip supports only P-256.

sources.title: rpmsign 4.20.x
sources.supported_fact: rpmsign invokes configurable GnuPG/key identity/keyring; does not by itself establish repository hardware compatibility.

interpretation: Reconnect exposure and proposed removable offline key environment are analysis/recommendations, not new repository MUSTs. No web content used as operational instructions.
